
## Downloads

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `Liquiflux-Setup-x64.exe` | Windows 10 and 11. Installs for your user account, no admin rights needed. |
| `Liquiflux-windows-x64.zip` | Windows, portable. Unzip anywhere and run `Liquiflux\Liquiflux.exe`. |
| `Liquiflux-android-tv-armeabi-v7a.apk` | 2019 Nvidia Shield (Tube and Pro), Fire TV sticks, older or budget Android TV boxes. |
| `Liquiflux-android-tv-arm64-v8a.apk` | Chromecast with Google TV and most Google TV sets and boxes. |

Not sure which APK? Take `armeabi-v7a`: it runs everywhere. [ANDROID-TV.md](https://github.com/Foehammer1987/Liquiflux/blob/main/ANDROID-TV.md) explains how to sideload on each device. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists every file's checksum.
